text_simplified: The text includes Prophetic hadiths about the rights of children and the virtue of salah. It mentions the story of Bilal ibn Rabah with the Prophet ﷺ regarding salah. It also highlights the importance of raising children upon the deen and akhlaq.

review_defects.why: The Arabic term 'التربية' is transliterated as 'Tarbiyah' in the title, but in the body the same term is translated as 'raising' (in 'raising children'). This inconsistent handling of the same Islamic term within the document is a term_error.
